name: Live Stock Balance
query:
SELECT 
    product as "Product:Link/Product:150", 
    warehouse as "Warehouse:Link/Warehouse:150", 
    SUM(qty) as "Available Qty:Float:120", 
    AVG(valuation_rate) as "Moving Average Price:Currency:150",
    (SUM(qty) * AVG(valuation_rate)) as "Total Value:Currency:150"
FROM 
    `tabStock Ledger`
GROUP BY 
    product, warehouse
HAVING 
    SUM(qty) != 0
